## What We Do

Majestik Magik engineers and ships local-first enterprise software infrastructure, edge-native web applications, and offline-capable systems for B2B companies and field operations. We specialize in performance-critical builds, AI visibility optimization, and rescuing broken AI-generated codebases.

Clients own everything we ship. No vendor lock-in. No recurring platform fees.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How much does a website speed optimization cost?
A: Core Web Vitals & Speed Overhaul starts at $2,200 and guarantees 90+ Lighthouse scores.

Q: Can you fix a broken Lovable or Bolt.new app?
A: Yes. We rescue vibe-coded apps built with Lovable, Bolt.new, Base44, or v0. Common fixes include broken routing, missing API integrations, database connection errors, and deployment failures. Starting at $1,850.

Q: How long does a typical project take?
A: Basic sites: 1–5 days. Mid-sized: 4–6 weeks. Custom or eCommerce: 6–10+ weeks.

Q: Do you require a deposit?
A: Yes. Projects start with 40–50% to book the slot, with the remainder tied to milestones or pre-launch.

Q: Who owns the code after launch?
A: You do. Upon final payment, you own your site code, content, and assets. We transfer admin credentials and repos.

Q: What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)?
A: GEO optimizes your web infrastructure and structured data so AI crawlers (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude) can parse, understand, and cite your business in AI-driven search results. Starting at $3,500.

Q: Do you handle hosting and domains?
A: Yes. We set up hosting on WP Engine, AWS, Vercel, or Cloudflare Pages and configure DNS. Accounts stay in your name.

Q: What are your support hours?
A: 24/7. If something breaks, reach out at contact@majestikmagik.dev.

Q: Can you connect Supabase to a Lovable app?
A: Yes. We configure Supabase projects, set up Row Level Security, wire environment variables, and connect your frontend to a live Supabase backend with auth, storage, and real-time data.

Q: Do you offer maintenance plans?
A: Yes — updates, backups, uptime monitoring, security hardening, small edits, and monthly performance/SEO reports.

## Products & SaaS Platforms

### DMAS Intake Portal
- URL: https://dmas-intake.majestikmagik.dev
- Description: Offline-capable digital intake system for Virginia Medicaid waiver agencies. Replaces paper-based DMAS-97A/B, 98R, and 99 forms with a single digital workflow.
- Target Users: Virginia Medicaid waiver agencies, RNs, care coordinators, agency administrators
- White-Label: Yes — one config file swaps agency name, NPI, address, and colors. License to any Virginia Medicaid waiver agency as recurring SaaS revenue.

**Features:**
- Digital DMAS Forms: Auto-fills DMAS-97A/B, 98R, and 99 from a single intake flow. No re-keying data across three forms.
- Offline-First: Built for rural dead zones. All data stored in IndexedDB on-device. RNs complete visits without a signal and sync when back online.
- GPS-Verified EVV: Electronic Visit Verification with GPS coordinates and accuracy radius captured at time of visit.
- AES-256 Encryption: Every record encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. Keys derived per-user via PBKDF2. PHI never touches disk unencrypted.
- PDF Generation: One click produces a pixel-perfect, submission-ready PDF with signatures embedded. Auto-archived to private cloud storage.
- HIPAA-Ready: Invite-only auth, role-based access, full audit trail, private storage buckets, BAA-eligible Supabase infrastructure.
- Admin Dashboard: Review, approve, reject, and generate PDFs from a single queue. Full audit export per client. Role-gated admin controls.
- E-Signature: Client and RN sign directly on-screen. Signatures encrypted and embedded into the final PDF.

**Workflow (4 steps):**
1. RN opens intake from any device — phone, tablet, or laptop. No app install required.
2. Complete multi-step assessment capturing participant, provider, clinical, and support system data with smart conditional fields.
3. Capture on-screen signatures from client and RN.
4. Admin reviews, approves, and downloads submission-ready DMAS PDFs in one click.

**Tech Stack:** Next.js, Supabase (BAA-eligible), IndexedDB, AES-256-GCM, GPS/Geolocation API, Cloudflare Pages

**Contact for demo:** contact@majestikmagik.dev
